about.title: About Me
about.intro: I am a Software Engineer (M.Sc.) with over 5 years of experience in designing, building, deploying, and monitoring large-scale web platforms or applications. I specialize in Node.js, TypeScript, and C# for backend development, and in UI/UX solutions using TailwindCSS, SCSS. I also have expertise in creating interactive or 3D experiences with Three.js, Unity, WebGL, and Unreal. My foundation is strong in C++, LLMs, and Linux bash, managing Site Reliability Engineering practices to ensure monitoring, and scalability using CI/CD tools like Jenkins, Kubernetes, and Docker.
about.experience: Since joining adidas, this global enterprise has strengthened my focus on quality, reliability, and teamwork across cultures. Beyond development, I’m deeply drawn to sharing knowledge—I love teaching, mentoring, and helping others grow in their technical and creative journeys. With my recent relocation to Berlin and full work authorization, I am eager to join innovative engineering teams, with my abilites to foresee scenarios, solve complex problems, and bring about innovation and creative thinking to the table. Whether I’m writing code or traveling the world, I’m driven by the same goal: to connect deeper people through technology.
